note: Everything the Live model may do while the patient is awake. Same tools as tools.v1.json. report_finding omits responsive, patient_moving, breathing_normally, ems_arrived, and aed_prompting. Enums must match RescueCore. The model has no tools for overlay coordinates, step changes, stopping the metronome, or dialing.

function_declarations.name: report_finding
function_declarations.description: Report something you heard or saw about the patient or scene. This is an observation only. The app decides what happens next.

kind.description:
unresponsive: the patient has stopped answering or reacting.
not_breathing: the patient is not breathing at all. A person who is talking is not this.
abnormal_breathing: gasping, snoring, or only occasional breaths in someone who is not talking, even if they were awake before. A person who is talking is not this.
dispatcher_speaking: a 911 dispatcher is audible.
chest_pain: chest pain, pressure, squeezing, or tightness.
other_heart_signs: arm, jaw, or back pain, cold sweat, or nausea that could come from the heart.
limb_injury: a hurt arm, leg, wrist, ankle, hand, or foot, with pain, swelling, or an odd shape.
limb_discolored: skin on the injured limb is blue, purple, or pale.
heavy_bleeding: blood is flowing fast or will not stop.
neck_back_injury: neck or back pain or injury.
choking: something is stuck in the throat and they cannot cough or speak.
other_concern: any other medical concern, such as trouble breathing in someone still talking, signs of a stroke, a seizure, an allergic reaction, an overdose, low blood sugar, or fainting.
aspirin_unsafe: aspirin allergy, a doctor's warning against aspirin, or not fully alert.

state_version.description: The version from the latest state brief.

function_declarations.name: report_resources
function_declarations.description: Report equipment or people visible or mentioned in the scene.

function_declarations.name: say
function_declarations.description: Play one approved phrase by id. Only phrases listed in the latest state brief are allowed.

function_declarations.name: locate_object
function_declarations.description: Ask the app to find an object in the current camera view and point to it.

function_declarations.name: log_event
function_declarations.description: Add a note to the event log. It is labeled as AI-inferred.
